name: XiaoHua Zhou
major: Statistical Methods in Diagnostic Medicine, Causal Inference, AI-related Methods, Traditional Chinese Medicine, Health Economic, The Outbreak and Development of COVID-19, Statistical Software

paper_description: Since 2020, Professor Zhou has led his team to make full use of the cross-scientific research advantages of mathematics, statistics, and computer science to conduct research on the outbreak and development of COVID-19.
For a long time, due to the lack of efficiency evaluation tools, it is difficult to evaluate the effectiveness of traditional Chinese medicine.
Xiaohua Zhou has also made quite important contributions to the analysis of health care costs. The main difficulty of health economic analysis is the existence of a large number of censored data.
Prof. Zhou has developed a large number of influential statistical methods in diagnostic medicine. His most extensive work is in the field of diagnostic test evaluation.
Professor Zhou has made outstanding achievements in the research on Identification of Causal Effect, Robustness of Estimation, and Sensitivity Analysis.

title: Professor
